hero.title: Budget with clarity. See your money's whole story.
hero.subtitle: MyBudget turns budgeting cycles, real execution, and multi-currency accounts into one clear picture — from your first budget line to year-end trends.

auth.title: Secure sign-up in seconds
auth.caption: Create an account, verify your email, and get straight to budgeting — no clutter, no friction.

bankAccounts.title: Track every account
bankAccounts.caption: Register bank accounts, cash, and cards in multiple currencies, each marked as an asset or a liability.

budgetExecution.title: Log spending against the plan
budgetExecution.caption: Record expenses, credit notes, and debit notes, and watch the execution matrix update in real time.

budgetManagement.title: One home for every budget
budgetManagement.caption: Create, rename, and switch between budgets — perfect for personal, family, or shared finances.

budgetStructureCategories.title: Organize by category
budgetStructureCategories.caption: Group related expenses into categories so your budget structure mirrors how you actually spend.

budgetStructureCycles.title: Plan in cycles
budgetStructureCycles.caption: Define budgeting cycles with their own currency and exchange rate, and mark the one that's active.

budgetStructurePeriodsLines.title: Line-by-line control
budgetStructurePeriodsLines.caption: Set budgeted amounts per line and period, with revisions that keep history intact as plans change.

currentSituation.title: A snapshot you can trust
currentSituation.caption: Save a cut record of balances and execution at any moment — a frozen snapshot that never silently drifts.

dashboard.title: See the trend, not just the number
dashboard.caption: Lifetime trends, average behavior bands, and per-line charts turn raw numbers into a clear story.
